scope: V3-06 explicit registered static DOM text/font consumption in the actual target build; reuses uiProbes and the owned browser, not the BGS preview renderer

coverageGap.case: legacy-gap: target loads and registers the font but draws the text with monospace
coverageGap.interpretation: ui-data-consumption correctly checked its geometry-only contract; it never certified fonts. This is a documented coverage gap, not evidence that the geometry checker is broken

implementation.taskContract: No new task fields: runtimeArtifact, existing uiProbes and the explicitly requested new check. Plan validation requires actual operands; Review/Repair can reference the real consumer check through existing verifyWith
implementation.sourceCoverage: Every explicitly data.font-bound static node.text in the registered UI documents, at authored target viewports. Shared uiProbes may include known non-font nodes for geometry: the font consumer skips these only after bound-font completeness is established. Unbound/system fonts and Scene/Canvas fonts are outside coverage
implementation.inputs: Actual registry, UI sources, manifest/module/member resources, selected font and identical packed copies; uses existing resource checker and font cmap parser
implementation.expectations: Saved text and inherited/responsive fontSize, resolved with existing UI helpers, never an author-supplied expected rectangle or PASS
implementation.targetObservation: Chromium CDP actual glyph font usage, DOM textContent/fontSize and actual element screenshot hashes. Downloading a font or setting a CSS family is not sufficient
implementation.variants: Response-only saved-text duplication and effective fontSize +7, plus exact selected-font 404 suppression, then original response restoration
implementation.fontCausality: Original/changed/restored glyph usage must be one isolated custom font; suppressing the selected registered response must change both actual glyph-font signature and visible screenshot, then restoration must match the original. Mixed/custom fallback or no observation-based identity means unverified
implementation.errorHandling: Only the deliberately suppressed font URL's known network console error is expected. All original/variant/restored errors remain product observations; inability to observe clean suppression is unverified, not passed
implementation.sharedCapabilityChange: fontCodePoints accepts an optional host-resolved parser module URL; existing environment-based callers remain compatible. No second font decoder or global environment rewrite
implementation.historicalEvidence: Existing runtime-smoke, UI/pixel, Review/Repair checker versions unchanged; no old geometry evidence promoted to font proof, no automatic task or paid rerun

fontCases.sourceProtection: Synthetic tests assert original UI/font bytes unchanged; passed results become noncurrent when the actual selected font bytes change

regression.status: completed; full matrix before font-only isolation/filtering fixes, followed by final focused rerun
regression.stageBoundary: Full matrix captured font preparation before non-font probe filtering and the font predicate before single-font tightening. The font test module loaded before mixed/combined cases were added. Subsequent changes are confined to the font preparation filter and font status predicate; other browser branches/state/context/sharedFont are unchanged. All final font cases, combined UI consumer, shared fonts and versions were rerun in finalFocused. Do not describe these as one 215/216-case frozen full run
regression.trialNotes: Initial fixtures used paths outside their declared manifest roots and a verify-only plan with no develop owner; corrected fixtures, no product authorization weakened. Two local TypeScript narrowing errors were fixed. First full run was interrupted to audit default compact coverage: invalid zero breakpoint was already rejected by existing source validation, not a newly found product bug. Final source reuses the shared breakpoint helper; both valid compact cases passed. All trial logs retained; partial/intermediate runs are not final full evidence

checkerSelfAudit.case: mixed-fonts: selected Arial draws 1 glyph; alternate Times draws the remaining 10 glyphs, both custom
checkerSelfAudit.rootCause: Checking that all reported fonts are custom only proves a selected resource affects some glyphs, not that the bound text uses one isolated font
checkerSelfAudit.fix: Require exactly one actual custom glyph font in original, source variants and restored observations. No additional semantic Review, framework or per-example font-name rule

consumerHandoffAudit.case: combined-probes: one task asks for font and geometry consumption; probe collection includes a bound text node and an ordinary unbound button
consumerHandoffAudit.rootCause: Font preparation required every shared UI probe to be a font binding, incorrectly coupling consumers and forcing unnecessary task splitting
consumerHandoffAudit.fix: Filter known non-font UI nodes after validating every actual saved font binding has complete probe coverage. Unknown nodes and missing/corrupt font bindings remain unverified
consumerHandoffAudit.finalStatus: Both font-data-consumption and ui-data-consumption passed in the same task

finalFocused.scope: Final font preparation filtering and isolation predicate, all 22 font cases including the combined UI consumer, legacy geometry-only gap, plan authorization, existing TTF/WOFF2 cmap callers and checker identities

boundaries.browser: Existing owned Chromium; synthetic OS temporary projects. Full regression includes existing independent debug pages and actual CLI with loopback fake model, not a new remote DB UI acceptance
notProven: dynamic consumption of assetRef/member selection fields: current selected file consumption is observed
all glyph styling/shaping, weight/style/variations, complete UI fit or aesthetics
all font formats in actual target rendering: this matrix uses actual TTF; existing shared cmap test also covers WOFF2
audio, animation, 3D, Tilemap collision/sorting or complete gameplay
